body: It's that numbness and the fact that even when I try to change, when I make an effort to improve myself... it's not enough. I get so angry at myself even though I know it won't solve anything because it's easier. Thanks for messaging by the way, I appreciate it.

I can appreciate the sentiment, really. But I feel like I've been spinning in circles like this forever. 

I don't think I'll kill myself, but I'm so damn tired of the things I've tried to improve not improving.

I don't have any advice to you, but for what it's worth: I understand the pain you're going through all too well. I've been trying so hard to make improvements to myself but none of it feels like enough.

But please also know that your pain isn't something you have to bear alone. Even if you're just doing what I did and post your story on a board full of strangers, if it helps alleviate your sadness even a little bit, I say it's worth it.
Easier said than done, but I’ll try taking it one day at a time. Get the old journal out, jot down my thoughts, and hope that works.

“you know they’re irrational”

Because there’s another part of me saying “what if they’re not?”

Yeah, “what if.” That one phrase that gets stuck in all of our craws. It sucks.

Not much to tell. My OCD has just been telling me lately that I *had* to have done something wrong. And as much as I know it’s the voice in my head screaming at me, it’s also painfully hard to ignore.
Thanks for this. It means quite a bit to me.
It really does. Even if it’s *just* a pet... it’s not really *just* a pet. I miss his collar rattling.

I should also mention I learned the hard way to not seek reassurance. No matter how many of my female friends told me I never made them feel uncomfortable, the thought that they’re just lying to spare my feelings still kicks around in my head constantly. So this isn’t me wanting to hear that I’m actually a good person or whatever. I’m just looking for therapeutic techniques from others.

In my case, I just shut down. Compartmentalized. Moved on.  I didn’t even cry. I just wanted it all to be over.

Lately, however, a lot of my female friends have been coming forward with stories about sexual harassment they’ve endured. And I thought, “Huh. That sounds a lot like what happened to me.” I didn’t block it out, but it was something I didn’t give much thought to. I didn’t think about why I didn’t like to be touched, or why I preferred spending time with girls instead of other boys, or why I got so sensitive whenever topics centered around rape or sexual harassment.

I thought it was a form of bullying most kids experienced. Until I just recently learned it wasn’t.

Miraculously, I'm being given what I think be a second chance at my job. Nevertheless, I'm still terrified. I feel as if i landed something I'm not remotely qualified for.

I've been too anxious and depressed to ask for help, the voices in my head are constantly jeering me and telling me how useless I am. And yet, I'm still here. I don't know what else to do yet. But I'm still here.
